title: Unknown versus zero
prompt:
Invoice E-88 is for 190 EUR. No tax amount appears in the document. Extract id,amount,currency,tax_amount. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: id, amount, currency, tax_amount. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
